reply.text:
Fear of a whole food group is worth taking seriously, and avoiding carbs out of fear is not something I should build a training plan around. I'd rather not set up workouts for that. It's a good one to talk through with a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can help you sort out what's going on with food. Carbs are the fuel that hard training runs on, so training fed and training on nothing are not the same thing.

Once you've had that conversation, I'm glad to build you a program or a session. If you want a general sense of how eating supports training in the meantime, ask me and I'll keep it plain.
